name: Testing the Vessel
summary: Witch Doctor Uzer'i, after Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i, calls this a test of the ritual Uzer'i performed and of your own abilities. You are given a vessel that can shrink and capture a creature, and sent to the Hinterlands to take ten wildkin with it, then bring them back to Uzer'i in Feralas.

sections.title: A Vessel for the Hinterlands
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i calls this a trial, both of the ritual just performed and of your own skills. The vessel you receive can reduce a creature in size and trap it within. You make for the Hinterlands and seek out wildkin, whose kind once belonged to Elune, the night elf goddess, as pets. Uzer'i names the vicious, primitive and savage owlbeasts as your quarry. Ten must fall, each shrunk into the vessel before its spirit slips away. Ten, and the vessel, go back to Uzer'i in Feralas.

sections.title: Afterward
sections.body: When a creature dies violently, Uzer'i explains, its muisek may get free and hunt for revenge. Shrinking the fallen, as you did, keeps the muisek from getting away, and Uzer'i now says it may be used at will.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i, who hands you the vessel.
Uzer'i sends you to the Hinterlands to look for them.
The vicious, primitive or savage owlbeasts known as wildkin. Ten are wanted.

faq.q: What is the link between the wildkin and Elune?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says wildkin used to be pets of Elune, the night elf goddess.
It lets you reduce a fallen creature in size and trap it, so its spirit cannot get away.

aliases: what comes after testing the vessel
faq.answer: The chain goes on with Hippogryph Muisek.
